Image-to-image retrieval

ViT-B-32-quickgelu (openai) zero-shot. Top 5 matches by image cosine similarity for 14 target tiles. Blue border: the target. Green: the match shares at least one intersection type with the target. Red: it shares none. Type agreement says nothing about whether two tiles look alike, so judge by eye too. Under each card, the Descriptions section (click its title to collapse) shows the target's description followed by each match's, in rank order. Words that appear in both the target's description and the match's are highlighted: bold on yellow if the word is uncommon (under 25% of all tile descriptions), bold only if it is common. Everyday words like "the" and "of" are ignored, and matching is by exact word (plurals folded), so synonyms are not caught.
